key_points: Philip Morris raised quarterly dividend 8.8% to $1.60/share ($6.40 annualized)
Dividend increase reinforces commitment to returning cash and aligns with smoke-free growth strategy
Sector news (Turning Point Brands CEO change & guidance cut) caused PM stock to dip ~1% on Sep 21
No fundamental change in PM's operations or outlook from the headlines
Overall effect: modestly positive with limited near-term price impact
